display_name: Global Fishing Watch hourly AIS presence
permitted_use: Coarse loitering or dwell-duration proxies only, at grid resolution, as a descriptive diagnostic on the already-registered vessel branch.
prohibited_use: Never continuous global track reconstruction, never vessel-level distance recomputation, and never a replacement for the modeled shortest-sea-route distance used in the route-burden construct.
required_rights: Existing GFW account and token; the public presence product is gridded, not raw tracks
coverage: Gridded presence; identity resolution weaker than the registered port-visit product
estimand_relevance: Low. It could sharpen dwell diagnostics but cannot repair the missing-edge support problem, because the same AIS gaps that remove a sequence from the panel also degrade presence.
kill_criteria: Any attempt to reconstruct individual vessel tracks from gridded presence. | Any recomputation of route distance that would silently change the frozen construct. | Any use that implies AIS-dark sequences have been observed.
